# unifi_broadcast_group (Resource)

The `unifi_broadcast_group` resource manages a broadcast group in the UniFi controller.

A broadcast group is the internal-SDK grouping of members (typically access points) used by WLANs to scope broadcast/multicast traffic. This is distinct from `unifi_wifi_broadcast`, which manages IoT/Official-API WiFi broadcast announcements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A broadcast group scoping broadcast/multicast traffic to a set of access points.
resource "unifi_broadcast_group" "floor_1" {
  name = "floor-1-aps"
  member_table = [
    "5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87200",
    "5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87201",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the broadcast group.

### Optional

- `member_table` (Set of String) The set of member identifiers (typically access point object IDs or MAC addresses) that belong to this broadcast group.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# import from provider configured site
terraform import unifi_broadcast_group.floor_1 5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217

# import from another site
terraform import unifi_broadcast_group.floor_1 another-site:5dc28e5e9106d105bdc87217
```
